Stage 7o2a — matrix row runner

Command:
  PYTHONPATH=gui python -m zap2_gui.app --discord-observation-matrix-run-row <row-id>

Purpose:
  Simplify one observation-matrix row collection without silently starting privileged firewall state.

Main states:
  - baseline row: refuses if Zap2 runtime is active; otherwise starts read-only endpoint-watch window.
  - strategy row, workflow stopped: selects strategy as owner, prepares start plan, prints exact confirm/start/rerun commands.
  - strategy row, workflow running without sudo: prints the exact sudo row-runner command for nft counter reads.
  - strategy row, workflow running with sudo: delegates to the guided pre-TLS probe.

Safety:
  - does not launch Discord;
  - does not auto-apply nft rules;
  - refuses root-owned strategy selection;
  - does not import or execute external scripts.

Stage 7o2b note: baseline runner fixed endpoint-watch invocation to use keyword arguments, so `--discord-observation-matrix-run-row baseline` can enter the watch window instead of crashing.
